verdict.rationale: Milvus ships an official Python SDK, pymilvus, with a `MilvusClient` shown in the GitHub README and quickstart code. The docs state the same client-side code runs against Milvus Lite, Standalone and Distributed. The pack evidences only Python. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs in other languages (e.g., Java/Go/Node), in-depth SDK reference documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: This installs `pymilvus`, the Python SDK for Milvus. Use `MilvusClient` to create a client
from pymilvus import MilvusClient client = MilvusClient("milvus_demo.db")

With the same client-side code, you can run GenAI apps with Milvus Lite on a laptop or Jupyter Notebook, or Milvus Standalone on Docker container, or Milvus Distributed on massive scale Kubernetes cluster serving billions of vectors in production.
Milvus Lite shares the same API with Milvus Standalone and Distributed
